title: Esther's Banquet

questions.question: On which day did Esther put on her royal robes?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:1 (ESV): "On the third day Esther put on her royal robes..."

questions.question: Where did Esther stand?
options: In the inner court of the king's palace
questions.correctAnswer: In the inner court of the king's palace
questions.explanation: Esther 5:1 (ESV): "...and stood in the inner court of the king's palace..."

questions.question: What did the king hold out to Esther?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:2 (ESV): "...and he held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand."

questions.question: What did the king promise to give Esther?
options: Even to the half of my kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: Even to the half of my kingdom
questions.explanation: Esther 5:3 (ESV): "...What is your request? It shall be given you, even to the half of my kingdom."

questions.question: Who did Esther invite to her feast?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:4 (ESV): "...let the king and Haman come today to a feast that I have prepared for the king."

questions.question: When did Esther promise to make her petition known?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:8 (ESV): "...let the king and Haman come to the feast that I will prepare for them, and tomorrow I will do as the king has said."

questions.question: How did Haman feel when he left the first feast?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:9 (ESV): "And Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart..."

questions.question: What dampened Haman’s joy?
options: Seeing Mordecai at the king's gate not rising
questions.correctAnswer: Seeing Mordecai at the king's gate not rising
questions.explanation: Esther 5:9 (ESV): "...But when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he neither rose nor trembled before him, he was filled with wrath..."

questions.question: Who was Haman’s wife?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:10 (ESV): "...and sent and brought his friends and his wife Zeresh."

questions.question: What did Zeresh and his friends suggest?
options: Let a gallows fifty cubits high be made
questions.correctAnswer: Let a gallows fifty cubits high be made
questions.explanation: Esther 5:14 (ESV): "Then his wife Zeresh and all his friends said to him, 'Let a gallows fifty cubits high be made...'"

questions.question: What did Haman recount to his friends?
options: The splendor of his riches, his sons, and his promotions
questions.correctAnswer: The splendor of his riches, his sons, and his promotions
questions.explanation: Esther 5:11 (ESV): "And Haman recounted to them the splendor of his riches, the number of his sons, all the promotions..."

questions.question: Who was the only one invited with the king to Esther's banquet?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:12 (ESV): "...Queen Esther let no one but me come with the king to the feast she prepared..."

questions.question: Why did Haman say all his success was worth nothing?
options: So long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate
questions.correctAnswer: So long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate
questions.explanation: Esther 5:13 (ESV): "Yet all this is worth nothing to me, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate."

questions.question: When did Haman plan to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:14 (ESV): "...and in the morning tell the king to have Mordecai hanged upon it."

questions.question: Who restrained himself in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Esther 5:10 (ESV): "Nevertheless, Haman restrained himself and went home..."

key_verse_text: And when the king saw Queen Esther standing in the court, she won favor in his sight, and he held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. Then Esther approached and touched the tip of the scepter.
